reasoning: Amazon Q4 2021 results showcase a tale of two businesses: a surging AWS with accelerating 40% growth and high-margin advertising, contrasted against a retail operation weighed down by $4 billion in inflationary and labor-related costs. Management demonstrates high confidence by announcing the first Prime price hike since 2018 and projecting a recovery in operational efficiency as labor constraints ease ('sun coming out'). The transparency regarding capital expenditure (CapEx) allocation and the decision to break out advertising revenue separately indicate a commitment to quantitative specificity and long-term value creation despite short-term margin compression.
